description: Provision a Google Cloud Iam IAMServiceAccount via Config Connector. Fields mirror the iam.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 IAMServiceAccount spec.

description.description: A text description of the service account. Must be less than or equal to 256 UTF-8 bytes.

disabled.description: Whether the service account is disabled. Defaults to false.

displayName.description: The display name for the service account. Can be updated without creating a new resource.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The accountId of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

title: GCP Iam IAMServiceAccount
